entities.summary: Michael John Denton is a British biochemist. He is a proponent of intelligent design and a senior fellow at the Center for Science and Culture at the Discovery Institute. He holds a PhD degree in biochemistry. Denton's book, Evolution: A Theory in Crisis, inspired intelligent design proponents Phillip Johnson and Michael Behe.
